paragraphs.en: Live with {roommates} ? Have friends and family around you? Chances are that if you're looking to live a more sustainable lifestyle, not everyone around you will be ready to jump on that {bandwagon} .There may be times when you feel the need to {apologize} for pushing your ideals onto other family members.
paragraphs.cn: 和 <u> 室友 </u> 同住吗？身边有朋友和家人吗？如果你想追求更加可持续的生活方式，很可能并不是你身边的每个人都愿意跟 <u> 风 </u> 。有时，你可能会因为将自己的理念强加给其他家庭成员而感到 <u> 抱歉 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: I experienced this when I started {switching} to a {zero} {waste} lifestyle {five} years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my {husband} , as {he} {refuses} to be completely zero waste like me.I've learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you'll find encouraging if you're doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive {household} .
paragraphs.cn: <u> 五 </u> 年前，当我开始 <u> 转向零废弃 </u> 的生活方式时，就经历过这种情况，当时我和父母住在一起。现在，我和 <u> 丈夫 </u> 一起生活时也依然会遇到这种情况，因为 <u> 他拒绝 </u> 像我一样完全过零废弃生活。不过，一路走来，我也学到了一些东西。如果你正在竭尽全力思考如何在一个并不总是支持你的 <u> 家庭 </u> 中做出改变，我希望这些经验能给你带来鼓舞。

paragraphs.en: Zero waste was a {radical} lifestyle {movement} a few years back.I learned that the {stuff} we {accumulate} daily, from {plastic} {packaging} to single-use ( (供一次使用的) ) items, contributes significantly to environmental problems.I remember showing my parents a {video} of Bea Johnson, sharing how cool I thought it would be to buy groceries with {jars} , and have so little {trash} ! A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my {dad} {commented} on how {silly} it was for me to carry jars {everywhere} .It came off as a bit {discouraging} , yet {reasonable} , considering he was a fan of packaged {beer} .
paragraphs.cn: 几年前，"零废弃"曾是一场 <u> 激进的 </u> 生活方式 <u> 运动 </u> 。我了解到，我们每天 <u> 积攒 </u> 起来的 <u> 东西 </u> ，从 <u> 塑料包装 </u> 到一次性用品，都是造成环境问题的重要原因。我记得我给父母看了一段比阿·约翰逊的 <u> 视频 </u> ，分享了我觉得用 <u> 罐子 </u> 买食品杂货，然后几乎不产生什么 <u> 垃圾 </u> ，这样的生活方式有多酷！几天后，我带着我的第一批零废弃杂货罐子回家，我 <u> 爸爸 </u> 却 <u> 评论 </u> 说，我带着罐子 <u> 到处 </u> 走真是太 <u> 傻 </u> 了。这让我有点 <u> 泄气 </u> ，但考虑到他是瓶装 <u> 啤酒 </u> 的爱好者，这也在 <u> 情理之中 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Yet as the months of {reducing} waste continued, I did what I could that was within my own reach.I had my own {bedroom} , so I worked on {removing} things I didn't need.Since I had my own toiletries ( (洗漱用品) ) in the {bathroom} , I was able to switch to bamboo {toothbrushes} and {bar} soaps.I replaced single-use items with reusable ( (可重复使用的) ) ones made of {cloth} or {leather} , and kept a bin to contain things that can be {recycled} .I {also} offered to cook every so often, so I {portioned} out a bit of the {cupboard} for my own zero waste groceries.Perhaps your family would still buy {milk} in plastic bottles or pre-packaged ( (预包装的) ) {biscuits} , but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，在持续 <u> 减少 </u> 废弃物的几个月里，我做了自己力所能及的事情。我有自己的 <u> 卧室 </u> ，所以我努力 <u> 清理 </u> 了不需要的东西。因为 <u> 浴室 </u> 里有我自己的洗漱用品，所以我可以改用竹制 <u> 牙刷 </u> 和肥皂 <u> 块 </u> 。我用 <u> 布 </u> 或 <u> 皮革 </u> 制成的可重复物品取代一次性用品，并且保留了一个垃圾桶，用来装可 <u> 回收 </u> 的东西。我 <u> 还 </u> 时常主动做饭，因此我将 <u> 橱柜划分 </u> 出一部分，用于存放自己的零废弃杂货。也许你的家人仍会购买塑料瓶装的 <u> 牛奶 </u> 或预先包装好的 <u> 饼干 </u> ，但你对自己的个人空间可能有一定的掌控权，从而做出这些改变。

paragraphs.en: If you feel {desperate} to avoid waste, remember that change takes time.As you make your lifestyle changes, you may find yourself wanting to {speak up} for yourself if others comment on what you're doing, which can turn {itself} into a whole household {debate} .If you have individuals in your family {who} are not on board, your words probably won't {do} much.Sometimes it feels like talking to a {brick} wall and can often leave you feeling more discouraged.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你 <u> 迫切希望 </u> 避免废弃物，记住改变是需要时间的。在你改变自己的生活方式时，如果别人对你所做的事情评头论足，你可能会想为自己 <u> 辩解 </u> ，而这可能会演变为整个家庭的 <u> 争论 </u> 。如果家里有 <u> 人 </u> 不认同你，你的话可能 <u> 起 </u> 不了太大作用。有时感觉就像在对牛弹琴（对着一堵 <u> 砖 </u> 墙说话），这往往会让你感到更加气馁。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP+Fxyt/ox+WDCb+dhfH7KaYaJ4u5RsVmLondVmcHiLum9J1BQErGzJvzqa5GEIz4ZA==
